reasons.plausibility: The addition of Hf for solid solution strengthening and grain refinement in refractory HEAs is scientifically sound with only minor uncertainties about optimal concentration and phase stability.
reasons.testability: A side-by-side comparison of Hf-doped and undoped alloys under controlled high-temperature and irradiation conditions provides a clear, feasible test with a definitive success or failure criterion.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly addresses how to enhance mechanical performance of W–Ta–Cr–V alloys under extreme conditions and proposes a specific intervention worth testing.
